pattern.en: I was working when you called.
What were you doing at 8 pm?
While we were waiting, the bus came.

text.ru: Процесс в прошлом: что шло в определённый момент (at 8 pm) или когда что-то случилось. Длинное фоновое действие — Past Continuous, короткое событие — Past Simple: I was cooking when the phone rang. while — «пока» (обычно с Continuous), when — «когда» (обычно с Simple).
text.en: A process in the past: in progress at a time or when something happened. Background action — Past Continuous, short event — Past Simple: I was cooking when the phone rang. while + continuous, when + simple.
text.es: was / were + -ing: acción en curso en el pasado (= estaba + gerundio).

label.en: a past process interrupted by an event

exercises.en: I ___ a shower when the lights went out.
exercises.ru: Я принимал душ, когда погас свет.

exercises.en: While I was driving, I ___ an accident.
exercises.ru: Когда я ехал, я увидел аварию.

exercises.en: What ___ you doing at ten last night?
exercises.ru: Что ты делал вчера в десять вечера?

exercises.en: We were having dinner when Tom arrived.

prompt.ru: Напишите, что вы делали вчера в 8 вечера.
prompt.en: Write what you were doing at 8 pm yesterday.
prompt.es: Escribe qué estabas haciendo ayer a las ocho de la tarde.

exercises.sample: At 8 pm yesterday I was cooking dinner and listening to music.
